systems.system: Sistema Nacional de Identificação e Autenticação Civil (SNIAC)

note: Budget line record: CVE 33,108,344 proposed for FY2024 for the running of SNIAC, sub-line 9.4 of the programme funded from the identity-document fee (programme total CVE 306,516,802). An identity system by the document's own description; nothing on birth or death registration.
